SEARCH.MESSAGES_TOO_SHORT: Type a word with 3 or more letters to search messages.
SEARCH.MESSAGES_TIMEOUT: The message search took too long. Try a more specific word.
SEARCH.ERROR: Could not search right now. Try again.

NEW_CONTACT.TITLE: New contact
NEW_CONTACT.DESCRIPTION: Save the contact to start a conversation with them.
NEW_CONTACT.NAME: Name
NEW_CONTACT.PHONE_HINT: With area code. Without +55 the number is saved as Brazilian.
NEW_CONTACT.PHONE_INVALID: Invalid phone. Check the area code and number.
NEW_CONTACT.DUPLICATE: A contact with this phone or email already exists.

TRANSFER.WAITING: Request sent. Waiting for {name} to answer.
TRANSFER.DECLINED_FOR: declined the transfer of the conversation with
TRANSFER.ACCEPTED_BY_ME: The conversation with {contact} is now with {name}.

ERRORS.not_assigned_to_other: This conversation is no longer with another agent.
ERRORS.not_found: Conversation not found or not accessible.
ERRORS.conversation_changed: The conversation changed hands before the answer. The request was closed.

BRANDING.TITLE: Appearance
BRANDING.DESCRIPTION: Tab name, icon, logo and conversation wallpaper for this account. Applies to every agent in the account.
BRANDING.SAVED: Appearance saved. Every agent already sees the change.
BRANDING.TAB_HINT: The name and icon shown on the tab instead of Chatwoot.
BRANDING.TAB_TITLE_HINT: E.g. Somos. Leave blank for the default name.
BRANDING.FAVICON_HINT: Square PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB.
BRANDING.LOGO_HINT: Shown at the top of the sidebar. PNG with transparent background, up to 3 MB.
BRANDING.WALLPAPER_HINT: Background image behind the messages, like WhatsApp. Up to 8 MB.
BRANDING.PREVIEW_IN: Hi! Do you have forklifts for rent?
BRANDING.PREVIEW_OUT: We do! I'll send you the options. 😊
BRANDING.DIM_HINT: Lightens (or darkens, in dark mode) the image so messages stay easy to read.
BRANDING.TOO_BIG: File too large. The limit is {size} MB.
BRANDING.LOGIN_NOTE: The sign-in page keeps the default brand: the appearance applies after signing in to the account.

ERRORS.invalid_type: Format not accepted. Use PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF.

STYLE_HINTS.list: A “See options” button that opens the list on WhatsApp. Up to 10 options.
STYLE_HINTS.buttons: Up to 3 buttons under the message. With more options it is sent as a list.
STYLE_HINTS.text: Numbered options in the text; the customer answers with the number or the name.

unassigned_message.TITLE: Message without agent
unassigned_message.HINT: Any customer message in a conversation with no agent.

new_conversation.TITLE: New conversation
new_conversation.HINT: Only the first message of a conversation.

keyword.TITLE: Keyword
keyword.HINT: When the message has one of the chosen words.

SUMMARY.NEW_CONVERSATION: On the first message of a conversation
SUMMARY.UNASSIGNED: Message in a conversation with no agent (repeats after {hours} h)
SUMMARY.ALWAYS_CLOSED: No day checked: always outside hours
SUMMARY.HANDOFF: Opens the conversation for the team

CONTACT_FIELDS.none: Do not save on the contact
CONTACT_FIELDS.name: Contact name

WARNINGS.EMPTY_TEXT: Write the text the bot will send.
WARNINGS.TOO_MANY_BUTTONS: WhatsApp accepts only 3 buttons: with more options it goes as a list.
WARNINGS.BUTTON_TOO_LONG: Buttons longer than 20 characters are cut on WhatsApp.
WARNINGS.NOT_CONNECTED: No output connected: the flow stops here.

INSPECTOR.KEYWORDS_HINT: Separate with commas. Accents and case are ignored.
INSPECTOR.COOLDOWN_HINT: After running, or after an agent replies, the bot waits this long before running again in the same conversation.
INSPECTOR.TIMEOUT: Give up without an answer after (minutes)
INSPECTOR.TIMEOUT_HINT: If the customer does not answer the menu or question in this time, the bot leaves the conversation.
INSPECTOR.SET_PENDING: Keep the conversation Pending while the bot talks
INSPECTOR.SET_PENDING_HINT: It leaves the Waiting tab and comes back as Open when handed to the team.
INSPECTOR.ONLY_UNASSIGNED: Only in conversations without an agent
INSPECTOR.ONLY_UNASSIGNED_HINT: If an agent takes over, the bot leaves the conversation.
INSPECTOR.FORMAT_HINT: On WhatsApp: *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~. Tap a variable to insert it.
INSPECTOR.DELAY_HINT: Leaves a pause between messages, like a person typing. Up to 30 s.
INSPECTOR.BUTTON_LABEL_HINT: Up to 20 characters. E.g. See options, MENU.
INSPECTOR.INVALID_TEXT: When the answer is not an option
INSPECTOR.INVALID_PLACEHOLDER: Sorry, I did not get that. Please choose one of the options.
INSPECTOR.MAX_ATTEMPTS_HINT: After that it follows the Invalid answer output (or hands off to the team when it is not connected).
INSPECTOR.ROUTES_HINT: If the answer has one of these words it follows that rule's output; otherwise Other answer.
INSPECTOR.NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. Customer wants to buy. First message: ...
INSPECTOR.RESOLVE_HINT: Marks it resolved at the end. Off, the conversation goes back to Open.

EDITOR.INBOXES_HINT: Which inboxes the bot runs in. None checked: all.
EDITOR.PALETTE_HINT: Click or drag onto the board. With a block selected, the new one comes already connected to it. To connect, drag from an output dot to another block.
EDITOR.CANVAS_HINT: Drag the background to move · Ctrl + mouse wheel to zoom · Delete removes
EDITOR.START_LOCKED: The Start block cannot be deleted.
EDITOR.TOO_MANY_NODES: A flow can have up to {max} blocks.
EDITOR.LEAVE_CONFIRM: This flow has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

TEST.TITLE: Test the flow
TEST.SUBTITLE: You chat as the customer {name}. Nothing is sent.
TEST.PLACEHOLDER: Write as if you were the customer...
TEST.FINISHED_PLACEHOLDER: The flow ended. Restart to test again.
TEST.TRIGGER_UNASSIGNED_MESSAGE: In a real conversation the flow starts with any customer message without an agent. Send a message to start.
TEST.TRIGGER_NEW_CONVERSATION: In a real conversation the flow starts on the first message of a conversation. Send a message to start.
TEST.TRIGGER_KEYWORD: The flow starts when the customer writes one of these words: {words}
TEST.KEYWORD_MISS: This message has none of the Start keywords, so the bot would not start.
TEST.INVALID_DEFAULT: Sorry, I did not get that 🤔 Please choose one of the options below.
TEST.INVALID_LIMIT: Invalid answer again: the bot follows the Invalid answer output.
TEST.HANDOFF: Conversation handed off to the team. The bot leaves the conversation.
TEST.HANDOFF_TO: Conversation handed off to {target}. The bot leaves the conversation.
TEST.END_RESOLVED: End of the flow. The conversation is marked resolved.
TEST.NO_ARROW: No arrow leaves this point: the flow ends.
TEST.NO_START: This flow has no Start block.
TEST.TOO_MANY_STEPS: The flow went through more than {count} blocks in a row without waiting for the customer (is there a loop?). The bot stops here.
TEST.ALREADY_FINISHED: The flow already ended. Restart to test again.

LIST.TITLE: Bot automation
LIST.DESCRIPTION: Flows that answer customers on their own: WhatsApp menus with lists or buttons, free-text questions, business hours and handoff to the team. An agent who replies or takes the conversation removes the bot from it.
LIST.EMPTY: No flows yet. Create the first one with New flow: it comes with a ready start to adjust.
LIST.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the flow {name}? Conversations in progress with the bot stop.
LIST.STATS: Last 7 days: {started} started · {handedOff} handed off · {finished} finished
LIST.ORDER_HINT: With more than one flow on in the same inbox, only one runs at a time: keyword first, then new conversation, then message without agent.
